sources.title: V speeds (approach and manoeuvring speeds); typical jet values used: approach ~140 kn, corner ~330-350 kn
sources.note: Estimates for the slow and combat modes; not specific to one aircraft.

air.note: Fourth-generation fighter default. cruise and max are the published figures for the real aircraft (the sims model them closely); slow (approach / loiter) and combat (corner / attack speed) are typical values.

ground.note: Tank default. rush = published road top speed of the real vehicle, which War Thunder uses (some vehicles differ by a few km/h per mode); normal ~ cross-country, cautious and crawl for moving in cover.
